segments.text: And the LORD said unto Moses,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

footnotes.text: + he…: or, being an husband among his people, he shall not defile himself for his wife, etc

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, am holy.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: ¶ And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
